validated_scope: Programmatic public SetSize, three resize/restore cycles, Hide/Show, resize-before-Quit, actual physical/source/renderer sizes and injected center pointer mapping; one prototype window only. External20s watchdog not triggered.

review.safety: Programmatic public resize skips live-drag callback; Hide/Show keeps OnUpdate active. No unrelated app or preference changes.
pending_repairs: Preserve pending prepared.frame.Exit as well as error before discarding old-extent packet
Final capture must encode the last consumed packet at its last rendered extent if native window changes after frame limit
Store runtime mode at renderer construction: post-teardown device capability getter returns false and cannot report mode used during rendering
review.cumulative_review: In progress; final adoption/readiness review follows these repairs.

limits: Hide/Show is visibility pressure, not demonstrated compositor occlusion or minimize/restore
Pointer check uses injected physical center samples; actual native pointer delivery remains unqualified
Missing/zero handler timestamps around reconfigure/hide/close are not frame-drop proof
Selected descriptor totals0 do not account for every native heap/cache object
Timed close can join one unconsumed source packet; fixed final simulation equality is not claimed
Native live drag, fullscreen, relative capture and other-platform runtime remain unqualified
next_step: Repair terminal/final-capture and mode-reporting edges, repeat bounded cycles/capture correctness, then adopt only durable source/viewport synchronization separately from handler/timer diagnostics.
